question: 2026年2月GMV最高的5天是哪几天？
gold_sql: SELECT stat_date, SUM(gmv) AS gmv FROM trd_daily_shop_sales WHERE stat_date >= '2026-02-01' AND stat_date < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2026年2月广告花费最高的5个投放计划是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT campaign_name, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM mkt_ad_spend WHERE stat_date >= '2026-02-01' AND stat_date < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY campaign_name ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2025年2月退款成功的有多少笔，退款金额合计多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_cnt, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM trd_refund WHERE refund_status = 'SUCCESS' AND refunded_at >= '2025-02-01' AND refunded_at < '2025-03-01'

question: 2026年3月领取的优惠券里，已使用的占比是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(status = 'USED') / COUNT(*) AS used_ratio FROM mkt_coupon WHERE received_at >= '2026-03-01' AND received_at < '2026-04-01'

question: 2026年3月iOS端和安卓端的实付金额分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT device_type, SUM(pay_amount) AS pay_amount FROM trd_order WHERE device_type IN ('IOS','ANDROID') AND paid_at >= '2026-03-01' AND paid_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY device_type

question: 2025年2月仅退款和退货退款各自的成功退款金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT refund_type, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM trd_refund WHERE refund_status = 'SUCCESS' AND refunded_at >= '2025-02-01' AND refunded_at < '2025-03-01' GROUP BY refund_type

question: 2026年3月每天的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(o.paid_at) AS d, SUM(o.total_amount + o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-03-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

question: 2026年2月每天新注册的会员有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(register_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM usr_member WHERE register_at >= '2026-02-01' AND register_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

question: 2025年2月按退款原因编码统计成功退款的笔数
gold_sql: SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trd_refund WHERE refund_status = 'SUCCESS' AND refunded_at >= '2025-02-01' AND refunded_at < '2025-03-01' GROUP BY reason_code

question: 2026年3月华南实付金额最高的2家店铺是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS pay_amount FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华南' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-03-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pay_amount DESC LIMIT 2

question: 2026年3月从发货到签收平均用时最长的3家快递公司是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, t.shipped_at, t.delivered_at)) AS avg_hours FROM tms_shipment t JOIN tms_carrier c ON t.carrier_id = c.id WHERE t.shipped_at >= '2026-03-01' AND t.shipped_at < '2026-04-01' AND t.delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_hours DESC LIMIT 3

question: 2026年2月华东的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount + o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华东' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01'

question: 2026年2月金卡会员的支付买家数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.member_id) AS buyers FROM trd_order o JOIN usr_member u ON o.member_id = u.id JOIN usr_member_level l ON u.level_id = l.id WHERE l.name = '金卡' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01'

question: 2026年2月西南和东北的客单价分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT r.big_region, SUM(o.pay_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS atv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region IN ('西南','东北') AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY r.big_region

question: 2026年2月华中每天的实付金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(o.paid_at) AS d, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS pay_amount FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华中' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

question: 2026年3月华南中心仓每天的出库单数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(ob.outbound_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wms_outbound ob JOIN wms_warehouse w ON ob.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE w.name = '华南中心仓' AND ob.outbound_at >= '2026-03-01' AND ob.outbound_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

question: 2026年2月天猫平台各店铺的支付订单数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_cnt FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_platform p ON s.platform_id = p.id WHERE p.name = '天猫' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY s.name

question: 2026年2月华东各店铺的成功退款金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(rf.refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM trd_refund rf JOIN trd_order o ON rf.order_id = o.id JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华东' AND rf.refund_status = 'SUCCESS' AND rf.refunded_at >= '2026-02-01' AND rf.refunded_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY s.name

question: 缺货数量最多的前3个SKU是哪些？
context: 2026年2月有哪些仓库发生过缺货？
gold_sql: SELECT k.sku_code, SUM(so.shortage_qty) AS shortage FROM wms_stockout_record so JOIN prd_sku k ON so.sku_id = k.id WHERE so.detected_at >= '2026-02-01' AND so.detected_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY k.sku_code ORDER BY shortage DESC LIMIT 3

question: 和去年同期比呢？
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.paid_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(o.total_amount + o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-03-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-04-01' OR o.paid_at >= '2025-03-01' AND o.paid_at < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY month

question: 按月拆开看看
context: 2025年服饰鞋包类目的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.paid_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(i.pay_share) AS sales FROM trd_order_item i JOIN trd_order o ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN prd_category c3 ON i.category_id = c3.id JOIN prd_category c2 ON c3.parent_id = c2.id JOIN prd_category c1 ON c2.parent_id = c1.id WHERE c1.name = '服饰鞋包' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') AND o.paid_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
